activation_note: Never retroactive for delivered episodes: active from E15 (being reworked) onward, or when a manifest declares combat_unit_direction_policy=COMBAT_UNIT_DIRECTION_V1.

rules.CU1: COMBAT_UNIT_CAMERA_LOCKED: a combat unit is not rendered on a locked/tripod camera; the writer's authored move stays
rules.CU2: COMBAT_UNIT_CARRIES_DIALOGUE: a combat unit carries no on-screen spoken line
rules.CU3: COMBAT_UNIT_PROMPT_HOLD_LANGUAGE: a combat unit's prompt carries no hold/settle/tripod wording
rules.CU4: FIGHT_SCENE_NARRATED: in a scene with combat, combat units are >= 50% of the scene's seconds
rules.CU5: FIGHT_TWO_SHOT_FACING_CAMERA: fighters are never composed with both faces turned to the lens
